__abilitiesCards.name: Special Abilities
__abilitiesCards.desc:
Class Benefits:
• Druid Spells: Orison at will, 5 first level spells, 4 second level spells
• Fire and Electrical Resistance • Secret Language
• Identify: Plants, Animals, Soils, Minerals, Clean Water
• Free Movement and Pass without Trace: Pass through overgrown areas without leaving a trail and at their normal movement rate.
• Communicate with Creatures: Elves

Kit Benefits:
• Shapeshifting: Gain shapechanging power at 1st level rather than at 7th level. However, until 7th level only the form of natural creatures whose Hit Dice total no greater than half level. Can shapechange twice as often as normal. (Forest Shapeshifters, then, can change to animal, reptile, and bird form, each twice per day.) However, using this power more than the normal three times per day may have dangerous consequences. (See "Special Hindrances.")

Kit Hinderences:
• Limited healing: A Shapeshifter regains hit points only when resuming her human form, and then recovers only 1d4 hp. If the druid has 0 hp or fewer, they regain none with their human shape.

__abilitiesCards.name: Racial Abilities
__abilitiesCards.desc:
Racial Abilities: Twice as Bright Half as Long, Bonus Weapon Proficiency, Bonus Non-Weapon Proficiency, XP Reduction

Class Benefits:
• Spells: Cantrip at will, 1st level spell
• Theives Skills: Pick Pockets, Detect Noise, Climb Walls, Read Languages

Kit Benefits:
• Song of Companionship: Summon animal who become companions. Meistersinger and animal can communicate simple thoughts and desires. The companion has hit points equal to the Meistersinger. Animal transfers its primary sensory power onto the Meistersinger.
• Song of Sanction: Zone of good will, save vs. Paralization at -1 to ignore Mestersinger and any within in 2ft and favor other targets. 
• Song of Animal Charm: Song takes 1d10 rounds, animal is held temporarily spellbound, rolls a saving throw vs. paralyzation. If it fails, it is charmed as per spell. If it succeeds, it acts normally. If the roll was a natural 20, the animal is enraged and immediately attacks. 
• Influence Animal Reactions

Kit Hinderances:
• Wanderer: No-stronghold, no troops, just a few huts and cabins scattered across the lands.

__abilitiesCards.name: Code / Personality
__abilitiesCards.desc:
• Locked in: If you shape change more than three times per day, must make a saving throw vs. spell after each extra use. A failure locks you into her current form until the next day, when you can attempt a new saving throw. However, for each failed save, the druid's next one bears a -1 penalty. If three saving throws fail in succession, animal form is permanent, as if reincarnated as that creature. Only a polymorph other, limited wish, or wish can turn them back to human form.

Notes: Useful spells, Create Spring, Cure Madness, Druidsight, Favor of the Goddess, Speak with Water, Precast: Goodberry, Rosetouch

Wizard Spells: Armor, Charm Person, Read Magic, Regenerate Self
